I replied to Pree in a thread on their correction in #central-team. I confirmed the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47, which replaces the Dock 23 they posted earlier. They said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

Their earlier Dock 23 message is still in the channel. If anyone reads that one without the correction they could go to the wrong site, so Pree may want to edit or delete it.
